create_reach_base_env: create a ReachBaseV0 gym environment with a mujoco model path and robot site configuration
setup_reach_env_sites: setup reach base environment with robot site name, target site name, and target xyz range
get_obs_dict_reach: get observation dictionary with joint positions, velocities, and reach error for reach base env
get_reward_dict_reach: get reward dictionary with reach distance, bonus, penalty, sparse, solved, and dense reward signals
reset_reach_target: reset reach base environment by randomizing target position within configured xyz range
